import re

# Read the log file
with open('main.log', 'r') as f:
    log_content = f.read()

# Extract overfull hbox warnings
overfull_pattern = r'Overfull \\hbox \([^)]+\) in paragraph at lines (\d+)--(\d+)\n\\OT1/[^/]+/\d+ ([\w\s\-\'".,]+)'
matches = re.findall(overfull_pattern, log_content)

print("Overfull hbox warnings:")
for match in matches:
    print(f"Lines {match[0]}-{match[1]}: {match[2]}")
EOF
